cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 R14.41 AUDIT LAB — 362 RF Cases & Gear BACK Fix
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.41 AUDIT LAB CYD 3.2 ST7798: 362 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi cases. CI-stamped source SHA via BUILD; CATALOG and LIST_END identify actual scenario IDs and detect incomplete USB listings. Strict 3–30-second RUN parsing rejects malformed/oversized commands; END follows the request to stop RF. Wi-Fi AP MAC verification and bounded recovery retained. Browser Workbench checks connected firmware against selected cases before transmission. SHA-256 multi-part flashing; true receiver accuracy requires physical validation.
highlights: Strict serial parser rejects oversized serial input rather than running the truncated command prefix.
Firmware LIST_END confirms full case-list transfer with count and FNV-1a fingerprint.
R14.41: CI build identity, catalog verification telemetry, strict serial RUN parser and post-stop TRUTH END ordering.
111 additional v1.50 Wi-Fi manufacturer-prefix SoftAP transmitters, individually selectable.
3 additional BLE service UUID advertisements; full FFFA Remote ID emission already available.
220/220 upstream static lookup entries mapped to candidate emissions; 362 total cases.
Active AP BSSID readback and bounded retry before reporting RF transmission.
